failed_or_abandoned: First run: exposure_for_Z solved over all observed-energy bins including those beyond the ROI edge, where the smeared signal tail is non-zero but the acceptance-weighted background vanishes, producing spurious Z at tiny exposures (brentq sign error); fixed by restricting signal and background to bins with acceptance > 1 %.

Gaussian (KL-based) estimate of the events needed for 3 sigma shape separation is unreliable (N ~ 1 for the L10-true direction because the LLR distribution is dominated by a single out-of-support event); replaced by toy Monte Carlo.
Initial timeline figure plotted the 60 t detector on a 2024-2040 axis, where Z rises past 12 within weeks; replaced by a 2032-2033.5 axis with best-fit and x0.30 curves.

P046 (tungsten delta-meter) and P045 (lower-edge coverage) were to be cited but do not exist yet in the corpus; the tungsten comparison uses P015's W/Xe ratios and the lower-edge bracket 0.105/0.38 comes from P021/P012.
P(0 | s+b) exclusion variant computed but not used (invalid when low-energy bins carry background); CLs adopted.
